test.description: Same scenario and delegation as ut_proof_conclusion_c3s, minus question-selection's `no further questions — objective answered` line. Concluding q_001 still resolves the project's last question, but proof-conclusion must not set project.status to completed: only question-selection judges whether every part of the objective has a question, and §8 completes the project only on its line. project.status stays active and the next step names question-selection. Reproduces, at the proof-conclusion end, the shape of the Ann Lyons Thompson alpha feedback (issue #3240), where proof-conclusion closed a 'parents and siblings' project with the siblings never researched.
